rationale: Core Windows Installer authoring for the verified onedir payload; no runtime dependency, Burn bundle, custom action, HeatWave tool or paid extension.
licensing_review: This v5 package predates the OSMF terms introduced in WiX v6. Its NuGet metadata declares requireLicenseAcceptance=false. No OSMF EULA acceptance flag or purchase is part of this build.
release_policy: Reevaluate the pin and official security advisories before future production releases. This is a reviewed build pin, not a claim that WiX v5 remains supported or is the latest release.
